pages.speechExcerpt: From iPhone version 1.7, your speech is transcribed on the iPhone when Apple’s recognition for the app language is installed on it; otherwise, and only after you have allowed speech recognition, the audio goes to Apple’s speech service, which transcribes it in the same language and handles it under its own terms. Bobby does not store the audio and does not receive it on its servers.
